title: Board Brief: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Seals were bought without a specification for two years before the fire.
No check stopped an untested pump returning to service.

sections.heading: What happened and why it matters to the board

items.text: A pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test and the seal failed [FND-0001; EVD-0001].

sections.heading: What the investigation says about the management system

items.text: Spares were bought locally without a specification, and assurance did not see the gap [FND-0003].

sections.heading: Questions for directors to ask management

items.question: How do we know critical spares meet their specification at every site?
items.why: Local purchasing bypassed the specification for two years.
items.good_evidence: A sampled audit of critical-spares purchase records against specifications.

items.question: Which equipment can return to service without a documented test?
items.good_evidence: A list of return-to-service hold points with test records.

items.question: Which sites buy critical spares locally today?
items.why: Local buying ran without a specification check.
items.good_evidence: A site-by-site list of local critical-spares purchases.

items.question: Who approves a substitute part, and is that role filled at every site?
items.why: The approving role was absent here.
items.good_evidence: A list of named roles with their approval records.

items.question: How often do procedures change without a review of the hold points?
items.good_evidence: A procedure review log with hold points checked.

items.question: What do we know about restarts without test records elsewhere?
items.why: This restart had no test record.
items.good_evidence: A sampled count of restarts with and without test records.

items.question: How are spares and testing risks reported to this board?
items.why: Neither risk reached the board before the event.
items.good_evidence: A board report line for each risk with its indicator.

items.question: Which actions from this event need capital, and when will we decide?
items.why: System fixes may need budget, not only instructions.
items.good_evidence: A costed list of actions above the administrative tier.

items.name: Critical spares bought to specification
items.measure: % of critical-spares orders with a specification reference

items.name: Restarts with a test record
items.measure: % of restarts after pressure-boundary work with a signed test record

items.name: Procedures with reviewed hold points
items.measure: % of maintenance procedures whose hold points were reviewed this year
